stops.note: natron, a naturally occurring soda-like mineral
coined by Chaptal from Greek nitron and -gene (producer), for the gas found in nitre
Jean-Antoine Chaptal named it 'nitrogène' in 1790, 'producer of nitre'; Lavoisier called it 'azote', lifeless

current_meaning: a colorless, odorless gas that makes up most of Earth's atmosphere
